$comment: OIDC / OAuth 2.1 relying-party (RP) client registration template.
cwl-idp is the OIDC PROVIDER; each ecosystem app is an RP. Register one
client per RP via the Keycloak Admin REST API:
The generated client secret is stored by Keycloak and mirrored into the
ecosystem KV under secret/idp/rp/<name> — NOT in any RP env file. RPs read
their client secret from KV at boot. See docs/rp-onboarding.md. Known RPs:
OAuth 2.1 posture: authorization-code + PKCE (S256), refresh tokens, NO
implicit/hybrid grant, exact HTTPS redirect URIs only.
